name: kg_rename_label
description: Rename a KG node's label. Use this for typo / spelling fixes when there is NO existing node with the new label (otherwise it would be a merge, not a rename). The old label is preserved as an alias so existing references still resolve. Refuses to rename if another node of the same node_type already has the new label — in that case use kg_merge_nodes. Always pass a non-empty `reason`. Pass `dry_run: true` to preview.

inputs.name: reason
inputs.description: Why the rename is correct. Goes into kg_revision_log.

outputs.description: {ok, revision_log_id, old_label, new_label} on commit; {ok, dry_run, before, after} on dry_run.

arguments_prompt:
Arguments for kg_rename_label:
- node_id (required)
- new_label (required)
- reason (required)
- dry_run (optional): preview only
- finding_id (optional)
